answer: Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 45 aliases, and each one needs its own funded voyage account. Deposits are visible in relic, and mirror reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 30% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 4 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
